title: On the limitations of molecular representations
summary: Across the studied molecular representations, learned embeddings did not outperform fingerprints or physicochemical descriptors on graph, shape and ADMET similarity measures; conventional RDKit descriptors had the smallest median local outcome differences across four laboratory endpoints.
ai_technology: Learned molecular embeddings and conventional molecular descriptors

evidence.tested: Across the studied molecular representations, learned embeddings did not outperform fingerprints or physicochemical descriptors on graph, shape and ADMET similarity measures; conventional RDKit descriptors had the smallest median local outcome differences across four laboratory endpoints.
evidence.unknown: The comparisons concern selected representations, datasets and endpoints; no universal representation ranking is established.
